description: add of a generic host (`host.tld[/path]`, spec §4.2): the probe's `git ls-remote` reaches the repository through insteadOf, so the source is git at `https://<host>/<path>` (a trailing `/` dropped), or `/skills` for the bare host, named after the host unless named; the same base again is kept, another under the taken name refused; at 127.0.0.1:1, where nothing listens, neither git nor the HEAD on the tarball answers: exit 1 naming both URLs, nothing written.
